text:
Florida went and got Brady Tkachuk from Ottawa to play beside his brother, and the Tkachuks have spent the season on one line with Sam Bennett. It has been loud and even: 57% of the expected goals at 5v5, but 10 goals for and 10 against. The bigger news is that the Panthers are about to get their spine back. Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand are nearing returns, and Florida put Cole Reinhardt on waivers to make room. The forward group is about to get very crowded, in the best way.

Meanwhile the Panthers are 14-8-3 with 31 points and 6-3-1 in their last 10. Bennett has 10 points in 10 games, including a hat trick against Buffalo, and Sandis Vilmanis has eight, more than double his expected pace. Jacob Markstrom has been better than his save rate looks, saving 3.7 goals above expected over his last five starts.

The profile is a 52% team that lives on special teams. Florida's power play creates 1.06 expected goals a game, a real weapon, but the Panthers also take 5.16 penalties a game and the kill allows 0.82 expected goals. That is a lot of hockey played a man short.

Our simulations give them a 71% playoff chance. What to watch: which line Barkov centers when he returns, because it reshapes all four.
headline: The brothers are together, and help is coming
